top_choice_rationale: P001 (Katori and Ye, optical lattice clocks) rests on a single identifiable mechanism, the magic wavelength that cancels the lattice light shift for many atoms held Doppler- and recoil-free, with uncertainties near 1e-18 reproduced at several laboratories and with density and blackbody shifts understood quantitatively. It has the broadest, independent support. Residual weaknesses are the discovery-versus-instrument question and Ye's share, but a citation tied to the invention and realization keeps the boundary with the 2005 and 2012 prizes. P003 follows as a mature, replicated new symmetry class; P002 is a real discovery but harder to attribute to three spokespeople and sits close to the 2015 oscillation prize; no award is worse than any of these mature achievements.
recusal_note: No conflict with Katori, Ye, Kane, Mele, Molenkamp, Luk, Kim or Wang apparent from my profile. I direct WACQT and work in superconducting circuits at Chalmers, which would matter only for circuit QED or trapped-ion candidates, none of which is in this slate.
